summary: Mostly not. Buying as price dipped into a bullish gap, or shorting as it rallied into a bearish gap, did the same as random entries on 1h, 4h and daily. The result that holds up is continuation: on 1h, entries while price held above a bullish gap's high beat random by 0.22% after 20 candles, and uptrends carried it.

verdicts.use: Holding above a bullish gap (price above gap high)
verdicts.text: On 1h, price kept rising after these entries and beat random by 0.22% at 20 candles. It also beat random at 10, 50 and 100 candles. On 4h and daily the same level is fragile, because it rests on one stretch.

verdicts.text: Same as random overall on 1h, 4h and daily. In 1h uptrends it did 0.17% worse than random, as price kept climbing.

verdicts.text: Same as random on 1h, 4h and daily. A 1h uptrend result rests on 3 entries on May 16–17, 2021.

notes: On 1h, entries while price held above a bullish gap's high beat random entries by 0.22% after 20 candles. The luck band topped out at 0.14%. That comes from 22,626 entries in 1,948 separate moves, and it holds without its strongest stretch, Jan 6–12, 2021, and at 10, 20, 50 and 100 candles. SOL carried most of it at 0.41%, ETH added 0.21%, and BTC at 0.04% did the same as random.

Uptrends carry the 1h result. With the pair above its 200-day SMA, entries beat random by 0.22%. Below it they came in at 0.08%, the same as random. Price above a gap high marked continuation in a rising market and showed nothing in a falling one.

On slower candles the same level is fragile. On 4h it beat random by 0.35%, but only because of a stretch between Dec 27, 2020 and Jan 15, 2021. It also beat random at 100 candles but not at 10 or 50. On daily it was 3.82% ahead, but that rests on 20 entries between Aug 16 and Sep 6, 2021.

Gap retests showed nothing. Price crossing down through a bullish gap's middle gave 1,874 entries on 1h and ended 0.13% ahead, inside the luck band. It also did the same as random on 4h and daily, and so did the cross through the gap's high. The information sat in price holding above the gap, not in price dipping back into it.

Shorting into bearish gaps did no better. Price crossing up through a bearish gap's middle did the same as random on 1h, 4h and daily, and the 0.50% shortfall on SOL 1h rests on 2 entries on Sep 9, 2020. Shorting while price sat below a bearish gap's low did the same as random overall on 1h. In uptrends it did 0.17% worse, held without its strongest stretch, and also showed at 50 candles.

On a long DCA bot on 1h, price above a bullish gap's high fits as a filter beside your own start conditions, mostly when the pair trades above its 200-day SMA. In downtrends it matched random entries, so expect it to add nothing there. Gap retests and the cross down through a bullish gap's low added nothing on these pairs, so the DCA orders and take profit do the work. A short bot that opens below a bearish gap's low in an uptrend trades against price that tended to keep rising.
